items.quote: Just last night (Saturday) I got Jim's number from a neighbor who recommended him. Jim responded within half an hour and this morning (Sunday) the technician was at my door before 9 AM.
Called Jim at around 7 pm and he answered and I told him my unit was frozen. He advised me what to do that night and was at my house first thing the next morning.
Jim and his team are absolutely the best! They are reliable, efficient and cost effective! Highly recommend them for all your AC needs.
